{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Technologies ought to be contextually appropriate, considering use value relative to social necessity, energy demand and pollution for production relative to maintenance, and durability relative to recyclability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a philosophy of convivial technology, which facilitates interpersonal connection, can be easily replicated by different people under different conditions, and can be managed democratically rather than technocratically.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Embrace certain high technologies essential for modern material comforts and a high quality of life, on the condition their supply chains are rendered as socially and environmentally just as possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Examples of high technologies embraced include the Internet, laptops, mobile phones, high-speed rail, GPS systems and satellites, refrigeration, air conditioning and heat pumps, solar panels, wind turbines, and rechargeable batteries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"These technologies must be developed to satisfy requirements of appropriateness, including use value relative to social necessity, energy demand and pollution for production relative to maintenance, and durability relative to recyclability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for extensive technology transfers to and releasing of intellectual property for the Global South to meet their needs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Left must help birth a new, post-carbon cultural hegemony as soon as possible to rehabilitate, regenerate and preserve the conditions for life on Earth, given the immediate task of building a multiracial, mass, working class movement to transform capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
